options.en: The descendants of French colonists who began settling the Maritime provinces in 1604.
options.fr: Les descendants des colons français qui ont commencé à s'établir dans les provinces maritimes en 1604.

explanation.en: The Acadians descend from French colonists who began settling in what are now the Maritime provinces in 1604. They are not the same people as the Quebecers.
explanation.fr: Les Acadiens descendent des colons français qui ont commencé à s'établir en 1604 dans ce qui est aujourd'hui les provinces maritimes. Ils ne forment pas le même peuple que les Québécois.

source.quote: The Acadians are the descendants of French colonists who began settling in what are now the Maritime provinces in 1604.

verification.evidence: The Acadians are the descendants of French colonists who began settling in what are now the Maritime provinces in 1604.
